reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraph ('Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.') directly supports the preferred position that no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds the Customer.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original.

Deterministic check confirms no residual requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer; rationale's treatment of 'exclusive' uses (warranty disclaimer heading, nonexclusive license grants in our favour) and the resale-only restriction is consistent with the rule's detection guidance.
